title: Ford press releases Jan-Apr 1966 - 12130682
doc_notes: This document is a collection of press releases from Congressman Gerald R. Ford between January and April 1966, containing several references to UFO sightings in Michigan and his subsequent calls for a congressional investigation.

incidents.summary: At least 40 persons, including 12 policemen, reported seeing a strange flying object guarded by four sister ships land in a swamp near Ann Arbor, Michigan.
incidents.quote: at least 40 persons, including 12 policemen, said today that they saw a strange flying object guarded by four sister ships land in a swamp

incidents.summary: A recent UFO sighting by Emile Grenier, an aeronautical engineer employed by Ford Motor Company.
incidents.quote: an eye witness account of a recent UFO sighting by Emile Grenier of Ann Arbor, an aeronautical engineer employed by Ford Motor Company
